title: Where the NFT money went
scope: Preserved Ethereum records. Main transfer window: 2023-03-21 through 2023-07-31 UTC. Payroll follow-through ends 2024-03-08 UTC (2024-03-07 Pacific).
units: Exact ETH source amounts are Decimal sums of integer wei; ribbon widths show ETH, excluding the separate downstream USDC panel.
price_method: Coinbase Exchange daily ETH/USD closing price on each transfer’s UTC day. Mint valuation is at receipt dates. Dollar labels are historical estimates; they do not show realized USD. The same ETH is valued on different days at different hops, so USD columns need not balance.

wallet_labels.kyoko: Contract kyokoWallet; OpenSea bbykyoko.eth, creator of @ssrwives.
wallet_labels.payroll: Official @ssrwives post identified address as future developer payroll on 2023-05-12 UTC.
wallet_labels.coinbase: Exchange deposit label; account holder is not identified.

readout: 147.16 ETH raised. The two publicly linked founder wallets received 61.173333333333333332 ETH from the contract and deployer. The named payroll wallet received 56.01 ETH; the Coinbase-labelled deposit received 32.21 ETH. Additional deployer inflows were 3.031953645999154159 ETH. These are gross recorded flows and reconcile with gas and closing balance.
presentation_notes: Downstream flows include commingled non-mint receipts. No downstream percentage is presented as an exclusive mint allocation.
The payroll panel follows part of the 56.01 ETH already shown; it is not additional money raised.
Payroll is the published wallet label, not a measure of total development expenses.
The graphic displays transfers and account balances. The exchange deposit is labelled as a deposit.
Balance calculations assume the preserved histories are complete; no fresh live-chain request was made for this build.
